title: A BENCHMARK AND EVALUATION FOR REAL-WORLD OUT-OF-DISTRIBUTION DETECTION USING VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing out-of-distribution (OOD) detection performance (AUROC) of zero-shot and few-shot CLIP-based models across benchmarks with explicit covariate shifts (e.g., changes in image style, quality, camera locations, and temporal shifts via ImageNet-FS-X and Wilds-FS-X) to measure performance bias toward training data distributions.
Evaluating model performance drops on the ImageNet-V2 dataset compared to the original ImageNet-1k dataset to identify inherent biases related to the data recreation and resampling process.
